<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Escadas para Abastecimento</title>
<!-- CATÁLOGO FTS BRASIL — COLE TODO ESTE CÓDIGO EM UM ÚNICO BLOCO “HTML PERSONALIZADO” -->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700&amp;family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
:root{ --navy:#0b1a4a; --blue:#1a56db; --muted:#6b7280; --whats:#22c55e; --whats-hover:#16a34a; --bg-soft:#f8fafc; }
*{box-sizing:border-box}
.fts-catalogo-embed{width:100%;margin:0;padding:40px 20px;font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;background:#f1f5f9}
.fts-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
@media(max-width:899px){.fts-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:599px){.fts-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.fts-card{width:100%;max-width:350px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.03),0 10px 28px rgba(15,23,42,.05);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
.fts-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.05),0 18px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.fts-card__image{padding:14px;background:#fff}
.fts-card__image-inner{background:var(--bg-soft);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:1/1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.fts-card__image-inner img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .4s ease}
.fts-card:hover .fts-card__image-inner img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.fts-card__body{padding:6px 22px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.fts-card__category{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--blue);text-transform:uppercase}
.fts-card__title{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:22px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--navy);margin:0}
.fts-card__desc{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 6px;flex:1}
.fts-card__btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:var(--whats);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:10px;transition:background .2s ease;font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
.fts-card__btn:hover{background:var(--whats-hover)}
.fts-card__btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:#fff}
@media(max-width:400px){.fts-card__title{font-size:20px}}


/* ===== FERRAMENTAS DO CATÁLOGO ===== */
.fts-catalogo-embed{--fts-border:#e2e8f0;--fts-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.07)}
.fts-catalogo-head{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 28px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,#f8fbff 100%);border:1px solid var(--fts-border);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;box-shadow:var(--fts-shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.fts-catalogo-head:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;right:-110px;top:-150px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,86,219,.16),rgba(26,86,219,0) 70%);pointer-events:none}
.fts-catalogo-head__intro{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-bottom:22px}
.fts-catalogo-head__eyebrow{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--blue)}
.fts-catalogo-head__intro h2{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,40px);line-height:1.08;color:var(--navy);margin:6px 0 8px}
.fts-catalogo-head__intro p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.fts-tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
.fts-search{height:54px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:13px;padding:0 13px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.04);transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.fts-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(26,86,219,.12)}
.fts-search>svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:var(--blue);flex:0 0 auto}
.fts-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:var(--navy);font:600 15px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
.fts-search input::placeholder{color:#94a3b8;font-weight:400}
.fts-search__clear{width:30px;height:30px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#eef2f7;color:#64748b;font-size:23px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s ease}
.fts-search__clear.is-visible{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.fts-search__clear:hover{background:#e2e8f0;color:var(--navy)}
.fts-tools__row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:stretch}
.fts-select-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:54px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:13px;padding:0 12px;color:#64748b;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.fts-select-wrap select{border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:var(--navy);font:700 14px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;padding:0 22px 0 0!important;margin:0!important;cursor:pointer}
.fts-reset{height:54px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);padding:0 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font:700 14px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:.2s ease}
.fts-reset svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor}
.fts-reset:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue);background:#f8fbff}
.fts-filter-area{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #e8edf4}
.fts-filter-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
.fts-filter-label>span{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.fts-filter-label strong{font-size:13px;color:var(--blue)}
.fts-filter-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 2px 8px;scrollbar-width:thin;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.fts-chip{flex:0 0 auto;border:1px solid #dbe3ee;background:#fff;color:#475569;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 12px;font:700 12px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s ease}
.fts-chip span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:22px;height:22px;margin-left:5px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef2f7;color:#64748b;font-size:11px}
.fts-chip:hover{border-color:#93b4f5;color:var(--blue);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.fts-chip.is-active{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(26,86,219,.22)}
.fts-chip.is-active span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
.fts-card[hidden]{display:none!important}
.fts-card.fts-enter{animation:ftsCardIn .32s ease both}
@keyframes ftsCardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.fts-no-results{max-width:700px;margin:26px auto;text-align:center;background:#fff;border:1px dashed #b9c7da;border-radius:18px;padding:38px 22px;color:var(--muted)}
.fts-no-results__icon{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#eff6ff}
.fts-no-results__icon svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:var(--blue)}
.fts-no-results h3{font-size:22px;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 8px}
.fts-no-results p{margin:0 auto 17px;max-width:480px}
.fts-no-results__reset{border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;font:700 14px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.fts-no-results__reset:hover{filter:brightness(.94)}
@media(max-width:899px){
  .fts-tools{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fts-tools__row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto}
}
@media(max-width:599px){
  .fts-catalogo-embed{padding:24px 12px}
  .fts-catalogo-head{padding:20px 15px;border-radius:17px}
  .fts-tools__row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fts-select-wrap,.fts-reset{width:100%}
  .fts-select-wrap select{margin-left:auto!important}
  .fts-filter-label{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
}

.fts-catalogo-embed,.fts-catalogo-embed *,.fts-catalogo-embed h1,.fts-catalogo-embed h2,.fts-catalogo-embed h3,.fts-catalogo-embed h4,.fts-catalogo-embed h5,.fts-catalogo-embed h6,.fts-catalogo-embed button,.fts-catalogo-embed input,.fts-catalogo-embed select,.fts-catalogo-embed a,.fts-catalogo-embed span,.fts-catalogo-embed p{font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif!important}
.fts-topo-catalogo{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 24px}.fts-topo-catalogo__hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f5ca6 0%,#0f7acb 55%,#22a6df 100%);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif!important}
@media(max-width:699px){.fts-topo-catalogo__main{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;padding:20px 18px 14px}.fts-topo-catalogo__cta{width:100%;min-width:0}.fts-topo-catalogo__logos{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;padding:12px}.fts-logo-box{min-height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.fts-topo-catalogo__tools{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fts-filter-chips{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}.fts-chip{flex:0 0 auto}}

/* ===== AJUSTE FINAL SOLICITADO ===== */
.fts-logo-box{
  min-height:42px;
  padding:4px 12px;
}
.fts-logo-box img{
  display:block;
  width:auto;
  max-width:112px;
  height:30px;
  object-fit:contain;
  background:#fff;
}
.fts-card__body{
  padding:10px 22px 22px;
  gap:14px;
  text-align:center;
}
.fts-card__title{
  font-size:18px!important;
  line-height:1.25!important;
  min-height:46px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
}
.fts-card__btn{
  margin-top:auto;
  width:100%;
  min-height:54px;
}
@media(max-width:599px){
  .fts-logo-box img{
    max-width:96px;
    height:28px;
  }
  .fts-card__title{
    min-height:auto;
    font-size:17px!important;
  }
}

/* ===== AJUSTES SOLICITADOS: imagens completas e logos maiores ===== */
.fts-card__image-inner{
  background:#fff!important;
  aspect-ratio:1/1!important;
  padding:10px!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center center!important;
}
.fts-card:hover .fts-card__image-inner img{
  transform:none!important;
}
.fts-topo-catalogo__logos{
  padding:8px 10px!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
}
.fts-logo-box{
  min-height:52px!important;
  padding:2px 8px!important;
}
.fts-logo-box img{
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:150px!important;
  height:42px!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
}
@media(max-width:699px){
  .fts-logo-box{
    min-height:46px!important;
  }
  .fts-logo-box img{
    max-width:130px!important;
    height:36px!important;
  }
}

/* ===== AJUSTE FINAL: somente imagem, nome e botão ===== */
.fts-card{
  transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease!important;
}
.fts-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-4px)!important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.05),0 18px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.08)!important;
}
.fts-card__image{
  padding:14px!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner{
  background:#fff!important;
  aspect-ratio:1/1!important;
  padding:8px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center center!important;
  transition:transform .4s ease!important;
}
.fts-card:hover .fts-card__image-inner img{
  transform:scale(1.05)!important;
}
.fts-card__body{
  padding:6px 22px 22px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  gap:14px!important;
  flex:1!important;
  text-align:center!important;
}
.fts-card__title{
  margin:0!important;
  min-height:48px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
}
.fts-card__btn{
  margin-top:auto!important;
}
@media(max-width:599px){
  .fts-card__title{
    min-height:auto!important;
  }
}

/* ===== AJUSTE SOLICITADO: imagens inteiras e logos ampliadas ===== */
.fts-card__image-inner{
  width:100%!important;
  aspect-ratio:1/1!important;
  padding:10px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  background:#fff!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center center!important;
  display:block!important;
  transform:none!important;
}
.fts-card:hover .fts-card__image-inner img{
  transform:scale(1.03)!important;
}

.fts-topo-catalogo__logos{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:0!important;
  padding:8px 14px!important;
}
.fts-logo-box{
  min-height:72px!important;
  padding:4px 20px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
.fts-logo-box:last-child{
  border-right:0!important;
}
.fts-logo-box img{
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:220px!important;
  height:58px!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  display:block!important;
  background:transparent!important;
}

@media(max-width:699px){
  .fts-topo-catalogo__logos{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
    gap:8px!important;
  }
  .fts-logo-box{
    min-height:60px!important;
    padding:4px 12px!important;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;
    border-radius:8px!important;
  }
  .fts-logo-box img{
    max-width:180px!important;
    height:48px!important;
  }
}

/* ===== CORREÇÃO DEFINITIVA: produto completo dentro da área útil ===== */
.fts-card__image{
  padding:14px!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner{
  width:100%!important;
  height:300px!important;
  min-height:300px!important;
  aspect-ratio:auto!important;
  padding:12px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  max-height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center center!important;
  display:block!important;
}
.fts-card:hover .fts-card__image-inner img{
  transform:scale(1.04)!important;
}
@media(max-width:599px){
  .fts-card__image-inner{
    height:270px!important;
    min-height:270px!important;
  }
}

/* ===== AJUSTE EXATO DAS LOGOS FORNECIDAS ===== */
.fts-topo-catalogo__logos{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:12px!important;
  padding:12px 18px!important;
}
.fts-logo-box{
  height:112px!important;
  min-height:112px!important;
  padding:0!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:18px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
}
.fts-logo-box img{
  display:block!important;
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center center!important;
  background:#fff!important;
}
@media(max-width:699px){
  .fts-topo-catalogo__logos{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
    gap:10px!important;
    padding:10px!important;
  }
  .fts-logo-box{
    height:92px!important;
    min-height:92px!important;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   FTS BRASIL — AJUSTE FINAL CONSOLIDADO
   ========================================================= */

/* Fonte única em todo o catálogo */
.fts-catalogo-embed,
.fts-catalogo-embed *,
.fts-catalogo-embed h1,
.fts-catalogo-embed h2,
.fts-catalogo-embed h3,
.fts-catalogo-embed h4,
.fts-catalogo-embed h5,
.fts-catalogo-embed h6,
.fts-catalogo-embed p,
.fts-catalogo-embed span,
.fts-catalogo-embed a,
.fts-catalogo-embed button,
.fts-catalogo-embed input,
.fts-catalogo-embed select{
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif!important;
}

/* Movimento dos cards */
.fts-card{
  transition:transform .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease!important;
}
.fts-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-6px)!important;
  box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.06),
             0 20px 44px rgba(15,23,42,.12)!important;
}

/* Área útil da imagem */
.fts-card__image{
  padding:16px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
}
.fts-card__image-inner{
  width:100%!important;
  height:320px!important;
  min-height:320px!important;
  padding:12px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  aspect-ratio:auto!important;
}

/* Produto inteiro e sem corte */

<a class="fts-card__btn" href="https://wa.me/5521965457929?text=Ol%C3%A1%21%20Gostaria%20de%20solicitar%20informa%C3%A7%C3%B5es%20sobre%3A%20SAPATA%20PARA%20ESCADA%20DE%20ABASTECIMENTO%20BORRACHA%2075%20MM%20X%2025%20MM." rel="noopener" target="_blank"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M17.5 14.4c-.3-.2-1.8-.9-2.1-1-.3-.1-.5-.2-.7.2-.2.3-.8 1-.9 1.2-.2.2-.3.2-.6.1-.3-.2-1.3-.5-2.5-1.5-.9-.8-1.5-1.8-1.7-2.1-.2-.3 0-.5.1-.6.1-.1.3-.4.4-.5.1-.2.2-.3.3-.5.1-.2 0-.4 0-.5 0-.2-.7-1.7-.9-2.3-.2-.6-.5-.5-.7-.5h-.6c-.2 0-.5.1-.8.4-.3.3-1 1-1 2.5s1 2.9 1.2 3.1c.2.2 2 3.1 4.9 4.4.7.3 1.2.5 1.6.6.7.2 1.3.2 1.8.1.6-.1 1.8-.7 2-1.4.3-.7.3-1.3.2-1.4-.1-.2-.3-.2-.6-.4zM12 2C6.5 2 2 6.5 2 12c0 1.8.5 3.4 1.3 4.9L2 22l5.3-1.3c1.4.8 3 1.3 4.7 1.3 5.5 0 10-4.5 10-10S17.5 2 12 2zm0 18c-1.5 0-3-.4-4.3-1.2l-.3-.2-3.1.8.8-3-.2-.3C4.4 15 4 13.5 4 12c0-4.4 3.6-8 8-8s8 3.6 8 8-3.6 8-8 8z"></path></svg> Fale com o nosso consultor</a>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  const root = document.querySelector('.fts-catalogo-embed');
  if(!root || root.dataset.filtersReady === 'true') return;
  root.dataset.filtersReady = 'true';

  const grid = root.querySelector('.fts-grid');
  const cards = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.fts-card'));
  const search = root.querySelector('#fts-search-input');
  const clearSearch = root.querySelector('.fts-search__clear');
  const sort = root.querySelector('#fts-sort');
  const chips = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.fts-chip'));
  const resetButtons = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.fts-reset, .fts-no-results__reset'));
  const resultCount = root.querySelector('#fts-result-count');
  const noResults = root.querySelector('.fts-no-results');

  let activeFilter = 'all';

  const normalize = (value) => (value || '')
    .toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR')
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .trim();

  cards.forEach(card => {
    card.dataset.normalizedSearch = normalize(card.dataset.search);
    card.dataset.normalizedTitle = normalize(card.dataset.title);
  });

  function sortCards(){
    const mode = sort.value;
    const ordered = [...cards].sort((a,b) => {
      if(mode === 'az') return a.dataset.normalizedTitle.localeCompare(b.dataset.normalizedTitle, 'pt-BR');
      if(mode === 'za') return b.dataset.normalizedTitle.localeCompare(a.dataset.normalizedTitle, 'pt-BR');
      return Number(a.dataset.index) - Number(b.dataset.index);
    });
    ordered.forEach(card => grid.appendChild(card));
  }

  function applyFilters(){
    const term = normalize(search.value);
    let visible = 0;

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const matchesCategory = activeFilter === 'all' || card.dataset.category === activeFilter;
      const matchesSearch = !term || card.dataset.normalizedSearch.includes(term);
      const show = matchesCategory && matchesSearch;

      card.hidden = !show;
      card.classList.remove('fts-enter');

      if(show){
        visible++;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => card.classList.add('fts-enter'));
      }
    });

    resultCount.textContent = visible === 1
      ? '1 produto encontrado'
      : visible + ' produtos encontrados';

    noResults.hidden = visible !== 0;
    grid.hidden = visible === 0;
    clearSearch.classList.toggle('is-visible', search.value.length > 0);
  }

  chips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeFilter = chip.dataset.filter;
      chips.forEach(item => {
        const selected = item === chip;
        item.classList.toggle('is-active', selected);
        item.setAttribute('aria-pressed', selected ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      applyFilters();
    });
  });

  search.addEventListener('input', applyFilters);

  clearSearch.addEventListener('click', () => {
    search.value = '';
    search.focus();
    applyFilters();
  });

  sort.addEventListener('change', () => {
    sortCards();
    applyFilters();
  });

  resetButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeFilter = 'all';
      search.value = '';
      sort.value = 'original';
      chips.forEach(chip => {
        const selected = chip.dataset.filter === 'all';
        chip.classList.toggle('is-active', selected);
        chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', selected ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      sortCards();
      applyFilters();
      search.focus({preventScroll:true});
    });
  });

  sortCards();
  applyFilters();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
